name: evomap
description: EvoMap marketplace for Evolver on Grok: per-prompt strategy recall, evidence-backed reuse reports and session-end distillation, powered by the Genome Evolution Protocol (GEP).

plugins.name: evolver-plugin
plugins.description: Evolver for Grok, from hooks with no tools: recalls one EvoMap strategy per prompt and hands it to the model at the turn's first tool result, reports each reuse with the checks the turn ran, and distills verified work into drafts you publish or discard.
